claims.wording: JunkYard Cleaner is offered by ehsan azish, with its developer website at 3nsofts.com/junkyard.
claims.excerpt: Seller: ehsan azish; Developer Website: https://www.3nsofts.com/junkyard
claims.condition: Reciprocal link from reused official homepage establishes app identity; not corporate ownership research

claims.wording: The Apple listing identifies version 4.1 and macOS 14.0 or later, Only for Mac.
claims.excerpt: Only for Mac; Version 4.1 Sep 26; Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
claims.condition: US storefront; update year not independently established; architectures unknown

claims.wording: The US listing displays Free; exact Pro workspace entitlement and price remain unverified.
claims.condition: Not proof all workspaces are free; homepage calls Developer Tools an Additional Pro workspace; no checkout tested

claims.wording: JunkYard documents separate review for personal files and confirmation before moving selected clutter to Trash.
claims.excerpt: JunkYard can preselect safe, rebuildable clutter in Guided Recovery. It still shows the selection and total amount for your confirmation before moving anything to Trash.
claims.condition: Vendor terminology Safe is a category label, not an editorial safety guarantee

claims.wording: The documented Downloads workspace filters installers, archives, large files and older files without selecting them solely for age.
claims.excerpt: Nothing is selected for you simply because it is old. Filter installers, archives, large files, and older files

claims.wording: Application Uninstaller and App Leftovers show candidate locations and sizes for review.
claims.excerpt: Find caches, support files, preferences, and web storage; Show the location and size of every candidate; Require review before any leftover is selected
claims.condition: Not proof every leftover is found

claims.wording: Storage Map compares Home-folder area sizes with the previous scan.
claims.excerpt: Storage Map shows which Home-folder areas use the most space and compares them with your previous scan.

claims.wording: A move to Trash does not necessarily immediately increase free space.
claims.excerpt: Their storage is not released until you empty the Trash, and macOS may take time to reconcile its storage figures.
claims.condition: No deletion or measured savings performed

claims.wording: The documented core onboarding asks users to select Home and retains a security-scoped bookmark.
claims.excerpt: During onboarding, you choose your Home folder. JunkYard stores that permission as a security-scoped bookmark
claims.condition: Core no-Full-Disk-Access wording does not imply optional backup access needs no additional permission

claims.wording: The current listing mentions optional Full Disk Access for old iPhone and iPad backups.
claims.excerpt: Old iPhone and iPad backups (with optional Full Disk Access)
claims.condition: Version 4.1 listing; qualify older homepage wording

claims.wording: Version 4.1 documents menu-bar metrics and optional alerts, with scheduled scans that notify rather than delete.
claims.excerpt: Storage, CPU, memory, network and battery at a glance. Optional alerts for low drive space, heavy memory use, fast battery drain and removed apps. Scheduled scans (daily or weekly) that only notify you and never remove anything on their own.
claims.condition: No helper grouping, performance or alert-delivery tests inferred

claims.wording: The newer release notes call the unified scan Smart Care rather than the homepage's Guided Recovery.
claims.excerpt: Smart Care One scan checks cleanup, app leftovers, downloads and storage together.
claims.condition: Retain version-specific labels; homepage last updated August 7

claims.wording: The homepage describes Developer Tools for Xcode artifacts, simulator data, package caches and device support files as an additional Pro workspace.
claims.excerpt: Additional Pro workspace; Developer Tools identifies Xcode build artifacts, simulator data, package caches, device support files, and other rebuildable development storage
claims.condition: Exact adapter coverage, paid entitlement and price unknown; do not claim all developer features free

claims.wording: The vendor policy says scan results remain local, internet is not required and the app does not require account creation.
claims.excerpt: All scan results are stored locally on your Mac and never transmitted elsewhere; We do NOT require you to create an account; No internet connection is required for the app to function
claims.condition: Attributed policy only; not independently audited network behavior or App Store account requirements
